title: swiftmailer/swiftmailer is abandoned
summary: Packagist marks swiftmailer/swiftmailer as abandoned and no longer maintained, and the author suggests using symfony/mailer instead. The Symfony project set Swiftmailer's end of maintenance for the end of November 2021.

constraints: Preserve message construction, transport configuration, and delivery behavior while moving from Swiftmailer to Symfony Mailer.
Keep composer.json, composer.lock, and any package that still requires swiftmailer/swiftmailer consistent after the replacement.

steps.title: Replace the dependency
steps.instructions: Remove swiftmailer/swiftmailer from composer.json and require symfony/mailer (and any transport packages the project needs), then run `composer update`.

steps.title: Migrate Swiftmailer usages
steps.instructions: Replace reported Swift_Mailer and Swift_Message requires, use statements, constructors, and newInstance calls with the Symfony Mailer Email and Mailer APIs.

verification.purpose: Confirm the Composer project is valid and symfony/mailer is installed.
Validate the Composer project and run the PHPUnit suite with the replacement mailer.
